Package com.csse3200.game.cards.effects

Class CardEffectResolutionService

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.cards.effects.CardEffectResolutionService
public final class CardEffectResolutionService extends Object
Public Team 5 entry point for resolving cards and querying the current turn's results.

The service owns only Team 5's calculation state and result history. It does not apply the returned effects to real player or enemy statistics; consuming systems remain responsible for those entity updates.
